title: Big Buck Bunny
description: A giant rabbit deals with three bullying rodents. Open-source animated short, great for testing embeds.

title: Sintel
description: A lone girl fights to save a baby dragon in this Blender Foundation short film.

title: Tears of Steel
description: A group of warriors and scientists gather to stage a crucial event in a war against robots.

title: Spring
description: A shepherd girl and her dog face ancient spirits to keep the cycle of life going, in this Blender Studio fantasy short.

title: Cosmos Laundromat: First Cycle
description: A suicidal sheep named Franck is offered a chance to live all the lives he ever wanted, in this absurdist sci-fi Blender Foundation short.

title: Sherlock Jr.
description: A film projectionist dreams himself into the movie he's screening to solve a mystery and win back his girl, in Buster Keaton's 1924 silent classic.

title: The General
description: A train engineer chases his stolen locomotive behind enemy lines to save it — and the woman he loves — in Buster Keaton's 1926 action-comedy.

title: Nosferatu
description: A mysterious count draws a young clerk into his shadowy world in F.W. Murnau's 1922 German Expressionist horror classic.

title: Night of the Living Dead
description: Strangers holed up in a rural farmhouse battle relentless attacks from the reanimated dead, in George Romero's genre-defining 1968 horror film.
